So 10 liters = 10 / 3.78541 = ~2.6417 gallons. But we need to fill up the tank. The user says "Please go ahead and fill up the tank". That implies fill to full capacity. So we need to fill the remaining amount: 50 gallons - current gallons. But we only know current fuel level in liters. We need to convert 10 liters to gallons: 10 / 3.78541 = 2.6417 gallons. So remaining = 50 - 2.6417 = 47.3583 gallons. So call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = 47.3583. Use round maybe. Let's round to 2 decimal places: 47.36 gallons.
